title: Gingival recession coverage: Do we still need autogenous grafts?
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Abstract, verbatim (no separate conclusion section): “More recently, 3D collagen matrices of human and porcine origin have been introduced as possible alternatives to autogenous connective tissue grafts in recession coverage procedures. This paper 45 aims to give an overview on the possible use of collagen matrices as soft tissue substitutes and a possible alternative to connective tissue grafts in the surgical treatment of gingival recession defects.” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
